data.value: During the first week of October 2012, will major national polling organizations publicly release at least three new head-to-head surveys on the Obama-Romney presidential race?

The 2012 U.S. presidential election is between incumbent Barack Obama and challenger Mitt Romney. Major national polling organizations regularly conduct and release head-to-head surveys. The first week of October 2012 runs from Monday October 1 to Sunday October 7. The simulation starts at 9:00 AM EDT on October 1, 2012.
